snippet.title: Tomboys Need Love Too! -  Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for Tomboys Need Love Too!

Tomboys Need Love Too is an adult visual novel about a young man whose heart is torn between his crush and his childhood friend.

Created by Zetsubou
https://twitter.com/ZetsubouGames

Music by Mario Luengo
https://soundcloud.com/mario-luengo

Sprites and CGs by Adyrn
https://twitter.com/AdyrnDraws

Backgrounds by VelinquenT
https://twitter.com/VelinquenT

GUI Artwork by Kingv
https://twitter.com/EnergyRain

Video by WhiteCharisma
https://www.facebook.com/WhiteCharismaLastFlight
